feature: Portal Shell (Git #1824): the Tenant Status card / scan status and progress. Three real backends combined per docs/scan-progress-sse-contract-pack.md (#2520) -- GET /api/portal/scan-status (poll), GET /api/portal/scan-plan (the run's check-key plan), and the run-scoped SSE stream GET /api/msp/customers/:customerId/diagnostics/runs/:runId/sse -- feeding artifacts/portal/src/components/shell/useScanState.ts, rendered by TenantStatusCard.tsx (sidebar footer) and ScanLogPanel.tsx (the right-slide scan log, README 'Right-slide detail panel').
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL for the uiSteps below -- the new artifacts/portal shell sits behind the same real auth as every other portal page.

apiTests ARE THE VERIFIED PORTION THIS SESSION. artifacts/portal's own vite build (and therefore tsc --noEmit for the whole app) is currently blocked by a pre-existing, already-filed, unrelated dependency gap -- Git #2546 (shared main-checkout node_modules/.pnpm/class-variance-authority@0.7.1 store entry is empty, confirmed still reproducing at the time this manifest was written: `ls` on that path shows an empty dir, no package.json/dist). That blocks BOTH the local worktree build AND the deployed dev-server build of this specific app (the empty store entry lives in the shared main checkout, not a worktree junction), so shaneapp://runTest cannot currently reach a working artifacts/portal build to drive the uiSteps below against. This is the Git #2160 'genuinely unreachable, after a real check' case, not an assumed default limitation -- the apiTests portion (hits api-server directly, unaffected by #2546) WAS run this session; see this manifest's own lastVerifiedAgainstCommit / the build's bookend for the real pass/fail result. The uiSteps are written now for real future coverage once #2546 clears, not left un-thought-through.

THE CARD ITSELF: sits in SidebarNav's footerSlot (reserved by #1819), gated by isTestbed for the CTA -- 'Real customers never get a self-serve scan trigger' (portal-assessment.ts's own comment on POST /portal/diagnostics/debug-trigger-scan, which 403s server-side for any non-testbed tenant regardless of what the button does client-side).

SCAN-STATUS-ERRORMESSAGE IS THIS SESSION'S OWN BACKEND ADDITION (Git #1824) -- lastRunSummary.errorMessage (populated only when status === 'failed') did not exist before this build; a cold page load after a failed run previously had no way to show why. Additive field, no migration (the column already existed on msp_diagnostic_runs).
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

apiTests.name: SETUP -- log in as the testbed account; extract the bearer.
SS1 -- GET /portal/scan-status is real and reachable for this tenant, and reports the shape useScanState.ts reads (everScanned, active|null, lastRunSummary|null, isTestbed).

SS2 -- isTestbed is present and boolean -- this is the real server-side gate the Tenant Status card's CTA visibility mirrors (client-side hiding is cosmetic; POST /portal/diagnostics/debug-trigger-scan itself 403s for a non-testbed tenant).

SS3 -- GET /portal/scan-plan is real and reachable, and returns the honest 'never scanned' shape (runId: null, checkKeys: []) or a real plan -- never a 404/500 for an authenticated customer with no run yet.

uiSteps.name: WAIT for the login form to hydrate.
goto the real portal shell -- the Tenant Status card renders in the sidebar footer on every page.
TS1 -- the Tenant Status header row rendered (real data, not the design's canned fixture).
TS2 -- the score reads either a real number or the honest never-scanned em dash -- never a fabricated placeholder.
TS3 -- open the scan log panel from the header row.
TS5 -- the panel names Scan progress.
